Job Description:

The CIO Private Bank AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) is the core AI enablement function of Deutsche Bank's Private Bank. We enable the Private Bank business and CIOs to deliver their AI ambitions faster, more safely and at lower cost. We drive delivery across business areas, make reusability the standard and build central AI capabilities. 

We work in a forward-deployed model: AI  acceleration leads, engineers, architects and agent operators are embedded in the business and CIO streams and accelerate delivery from discovery to production. You will enable delivery across the different domains and accelerate the portfolio in progress. What we build in one domain becomes reusable components, agent patterns and shared platforms for the others.

Our focus is delivering the Private Bank AI strategy and enabling its transformation. With the business, central AI Hub and the TDI CIOs, we accelerate one AI portfolio, prioritised by value, risk and reuse. We redesign processes end to end, keeping the human decision at the core, and we make governance operational, building evaluation and control into the path to production. 


The Director - AI Engineering is a senior technical and people leader accountable for translating the organisation’s AI strategy into secure, reliable, scalable and economically sustainable products, platforms and business capabilities. The role sets engineering direction across Generative AI, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems, moving solutions from discovery to governed production with measurable value.

The Director leads a multidisciplinary organisation that may include AI and ML engineers, agent engineers, architects, evaluation specialists, data and platform engineers, LLMOps or MLOps specialists, technical leads and engineering managers. Working with Product, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Cloud and Platform Engineering, Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Model Risk Management and business leaders, the role owns strategy, organisation design, portfolio execution, technical standards, operational performance, talent and investment decisions. Success is measured through business outcomes, adoption and task success, delivery predictability, reliability, security, control effectiveness, team health and financial efficiency.


Responsibilities

  • Define and own the AI engineering strategy, target operating model and 12- to 24-month roadmap, aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, data strategy and risk appetite.
  • Translate strategy into an executable portfolio, investment and workforce plan with clear outcomes, milestones, dependencies, capacity assumptions and success measures.
  • Prioritise AI use cases and platform investments by business value, technical feasibility, data readiness, risk, time to market, reuse and total cost of ownership; stop or reshape work lacking value or control readiness.
  • Own delivery across multiple teams from discovery and prototyping through architecture, engineering, evaluation, approval, launch, operation and continuous improvement.
  • Build, lead and develop a diverse, high-performing organisation; hire and retain senior talent, coach managers and technical leads, manage performance, establish career paths and succession, and close capability gaps.
  • Design team structures, roles, decision rights and ways of working that scale delivery across product teams, shared platforms and business domains with clear accountability.
  • Create a culture of customer outcomes, production ownership, high-quality written decisions, constructive challenge, blameless learning, inclusion and continuous technical improvement.
  • Provide technical direction and approve significant architecture decisions across foundation models, classical ML, RAG, vector retrieval, agent orchestration, memory, model routing, tool use, APIs, integrations and distributed systems.
  • Sponsor reusable enterprise capabilities including secure model gateways, shared SDKs, retrieval services, agent and tool frameworks, MCP integrations, evaluation harnesses, prompt management, observability and reference architectures.
  • Set standards for software design, coding, testing, evaluation, documentation, versioning, CI/CD, DevSecOps, model and prompt releases, traceability and technical-debt management.
  • Establish evidence-based release gates for correctness, groundedness, relevance, task completion, safety, robustness, fairness where applicable, latency, availability, cost and user experience.
  • Own operational excellence through SLAs, SLOs and error budgets, observability, capacity planning, incident response, rollback, root-cause analysis, resilience, disaster recovery and service improvement.
  • Embed AI security and Responsible AI by design, including least-privilege access, data protection, audit trails, human oversight, red teaming and safeguards against prompt injection, leakage, misuse and unsafe autonomy.
  • Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance and Model Risk Management to meet policy, assurance and regulatory obligations, including relevant EU AI Act and financial-services requirements.
  • Own portfolio economics across cloud, inference and token consumption, licences, vendors and partners; track unit economics such as cost per successful task and make build, buy or partner decisions.
  • Govern model and technology providers, balancing capability, interoperability, portability, security, data residency, concentration risk, lock-in, performance and commercial terms.
  • Partner with Product and business leaders on outcomes, acceptance criteria, rollout, adoption and value realisation; provide executives and governance forums with transparent reporting on delivery, quality, risk, cost and benefits.
  • Drive responsible adoption through reusable patterns, enablement, communities of practice and appropriate AI-assisted development; define KPIs covering value, adoption, quality, reliability, security, delivery, recovery, team health and financial efficiency.

Skills

  • Typically 12 to 15+ years in software, platform, data or AI engineering, including at least 5 years of formal people leadership with accountability for delivery and talent; experience managing managers or multiple teams is strongly preferred.
  • Proven success building and scaling engineering organisations, developing senior engineers and leaders, shaping organisation design, managing performance and succession, and sustaining engagement.
  • Demonstrated accountability for taking AI or ML capabilities from concept to secure, reliable enterprise production with measurable adoption and business outcomes.
  • Strong technical depth in LLMs, Generative AI, RAG, embeddings, vector stores, agentic and multi-agent systems, tool use, context engineering, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Broad architecture expertise across distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, data pipelines, cloud-native services and secure multi-tenant platforms.
  • Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including versioning, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, model serving, telemetry, production evaluation, safe deployment and rollback.
  • Experience with a major cloud and managed AI ecosystem such as Microsoft Azure and Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, AWS and Bedrock, or Google Cloud and Vertex AI.
  • Familiarity with agent and orchestration ecosystems such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK or AWS Bedrock Agents, plus interoperability patterns such as MCP and A2A.
  • Technical credibility to review code and designs with senior engineers and architects; strong working knowledge of Python, with Java, TypeScript or another enterprise language beneficial.
  • Deep knowledge of DevSecOps, software quality, architecture governance, observability, reliability engineering, incident management, capacity planning and production operations.
  • Sound judgement on AI security, privacy and safety, including prompt injection, exfiltration, sensitive-data handling, model misuse, privileged tools, third parties, access controls and autonomous actions.
  • Experience in a regulated or highly controlled environment is strongly preferred, especially banking or financial services; knowledge of model risk, auditability, segregation of duties, data residency and Responsible AI governance is valuable.
  • Commercial and financial acumen covering business cases, budgets, vendors, total cost of ownership, cloud and inference economics, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Strong portfolio execution and stakeholder leadership, balancing innovation, speed, service quality, technical debt, controls and long-term platform sustainability.
  • Excellent executive communication and cross-functional leadership across Product, Architecture, Data, Platform, Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal and business teams, with the ability to resolve ambiguity and escalations.
  • Data-driven leadership using clear metrics to improve delivery predictability, engineering quality, team effectiveness, service outcomes, adoption and realised value.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics or a related discipline, or equivalent experience; a Master's degree, MBA or doctorate is advantageous but not essential.
  • Leadership characterised by integrity, inclusion, curiosity, pragmatism, accountability and sound decision-making under uncertainty.

Well-being & Benefits 

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.  

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace. 
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.  
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts. 
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health. 

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups. 

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.  

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays). 
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work. 
  • Options for flexible working hours. 
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more. 

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future. 

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose. 
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals 

  

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub! 

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
